expected_issues.title: Deprecated asyncio.iscoroutinefunction() used instead of asgiref's
expected_issues.description:
The new async paginator uses asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(), which is deprecated (Python 3.14) and inconsistent with the asgiref.sync.iscoroutinefunction() used across Django.

asyncio.iscoroutinefunction emits a DeprecationWarning on recent Python versions and is slated for removal; Django standardised on asgiref.sync.iscoroutinefunction, which also recognises functions marked with markcoroutinefunction(). Using the asyncio variant produces warnings in test suites run with -W error and can misclassify marked callables.

annotator_notes: Upstream change https://github.com/django/django/commit/2ae3044d9d4dfb8371055513e440e0384f211963.
